basic_details.job_title: LTMG Hospital Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 11 Assistant Professor Posts
basic_details.notification_number: 18464 (letter number as printed on the notice, dated 26.11.2026)
basic_details.application_mode: Handwritten application form delivered to the central dispatch section, LTMG Hospital & Medical College, Sion, Mumbai 400 022
basic_details.short_information: Lokmanya Tilak Municipal General Hospital & Medical College (LTMG Hospital), Sion, Mumbai has invited applications for 11 Assistant Professor posts on contract basis till 31 March 2027: Biochemistry 4, Obst & Gync. 3, Biostatistician 1 and Radiology 3. Pay is Rs. 1,10,000 per month for Assistant Professor and Rs. 80,000 per month for Assistant Professor Biostatistician. Handwritten application forms must reach the central dispatch section by 4.00 pm on 4 December 2026, and interviews are on 8 December 2026.

age_limit.details: For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification and the National Medical Commission Regulations it cites.

qualification.details: The notice prints one set of educational qualifications and experience requirements for all the posts listed. | If the MS-CIT certificate and the SSC or HSC (Marathi subject) certificate are not available at the time of interview, they must be submitted within three months (MS-CIT) and six months (SSC or HSC with Marathi subject) from the appointment date. | For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification and the National Medical Commission Regulations it cites.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 1,10,000 per month (Assistant Professor); Rs. 80,000 per month (Assistant Professor Biostatistician)

how_to_apply: The notice describes a paper application. It names no online portal.
Collect the prescribed application form from Room No. 15, Cash Section (Head Clerk-Cash) of LTMG Hospital & Medical College on working days between 11.00 am and 3.30 pm.
Fill in the form in your own handwriting, complete in all respects, with a recent passport size photograph duly affixed.
Quote a clear and complete correspondence address with Pin Code, telephone or mobile number and E-mail I.D.
Enclose attested photocopies of the documents listed below.

Make sure the form reaches the central dispatch section of LTMG Hospital & Medical College, Sion, Mumbai 400 022 on or before 04.12.2026, up to 4.00 pm. Applications received after that date and time will not be considered.
The notice does not state how the fee is paid.
The interview is held at the Chambers of Dean, LTMG Hospital & Medical College, Sion, Mumbai 400 022, on 08.12.2026.

All selections will be made as per the NMC norms. Meeting the requirements in the advertisement does not by itself qualify a candidate for interview or appointment, and applicants found not eligible will not be informed individually.
important_instructions: A candidate who is in service must submit a No Objection Certificate from the previous employer. Candidature can be cancelled at any time and any stage if the candidate does not fulfil the prescribed qualifications and conditions, or in case of false information, certificates or papers, or hiding of required information. The Municipal Commissioner M.C.G.M. has the right to stop the selection process at any time and at any stage. Correspondence about late applications will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 11 vacant posts in four departments. The department figures add up to the total: 4 + 3 + 1 + 3 = 11. The notice gives no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice prints one set of educational qualifications and experience requirements for all the posts listed. If the MS-CIT certificate and the SSC or HSC (Marathi subject) certificate are not available at the time of interview, they must be submitted within three months (MS-CIT) and six months (SSC or HSC with Marathi subject) from the appointment date. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification and the National Medical Commission Regulations it cites.

rows.post: Assistant Professor (Biochemistry, Obst & Gync., Radiology) and Assistant Professor Biostatistician
rows.qualification: As per qualifications laid down by National Medical Commission Regulations dated 30.06.2025 for minimum qualifications for teachers in medical institutions, as amended from time to time; MS-CIT passing certificate; SSC or HSC passed with Marathi subject.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on contract basis and not regular, for the period till 31.03.2027. The appointed candidate can be discontinued at any time if not required. A candidate who wishes to resign must give one month's notice in advance. If Assistant Professors become available on a regular basis through direct service, the contractual appointment will be terminated. Selected candidates are eligible only for Casual Leave and Special Casual Leave as per circular No. Director/M.E. & M.H/3644 dated 14.10.2022, and for no other leave. The selected candidate will be appointed at LTMG Hospital & Medical College and can be transferred to Municipal Medical College as per requirement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for LTMG Hospital Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice describes a paper application. It names no online portal. Collect the prescribed application form from Room No. 15, Cash Section (Head Clerk-Cash) of LTMG Hospital & Medical College on working days between 11.00 am and 3.30 pm. Fill in the form in your own handwriting, complete in all respects, with a recent passport size photograph duly affixed. Quote a clear and complete correspondence address with Pin Code, telephone or mobile number and E-mail I.D. Enclose attested photocopies of the documents listed below. Make sure the form reaches the central dispatch section of LTMG Hospital & Medical College, Sion, Mumbai 400 022 on or before 04.12.2026, up to 4.00 pm. Applications received after that date and time will not be considered. The notice does not state how the fee is paid. The interview is held at the Chambers of Dean, LTMG Hospital & Medical College, Sion, Mumbai 400 022, on 08.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Attested photocopies must be submitted along with the prescribed form: Birth Certificate School/College Leaving Certificate Domicile Certificate Medical educational qualification certificates and experience certificate MMC/MCI Registration Professional Indemnity Policy Secondary and Higher Secondary School Examination Mark List (Marathi subject required) For married female candidates: Marriage Certificate and Gazette copy of name change PAN Card Aadhar Card Attested copies of undergraduate and postgraduate examination passing certificates, if passed in more than 1 attempt MS-CIT passing certificate

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: A candidate who is in service must submit a No Objection Certificate from the previous employer. Candidature can be cancelled at any time and any stage if the candidate does not fulfil the prescribed qualifications and conditions, or in case of false information, certificates or papers, or hiding of required information. The Municipal Commissioner M.C.G.M. has the right to stop the selection process at any time and at any stage. Correspondence about late applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Professor vacancies are there in LTMG Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 vacancies: Biochemistry 4, Obst & Gync. 3, Biostatistician 1 and Radiology 3.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application form must reach the central dispatch section of LTMG Hospital & Medical College, Sion, Mumbai 400 022 on or before 04.12.2026, up to 4.00 pm. Late applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Qualifications as laid down by National Medical Commission Regulations dated 30.06.2025 for teachers in medical institutions, as amended from time to time, plus an MS-CIT passing certificate and SSC or HSC passed with Marathi subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Not more than 38 years for Assistant Professor as on the date of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor (Contractual) gets Rs. 1,10,000 per month, and Assistant Professor Biostatistician (Contractual) gets Rs. 80,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 869 + Rs. 157 (GST 18%), a total of Rs. 1026.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Collect the prescribed form from Room No. 15, Cash Section (Head Clerk-Cash), fill it in your own handwriting with a passport size photograph, attach attested copies of the listed documents and send it to the central dispatch section by 4.00 pm on 04.12.2026.

faq.question: Q8. When and where is the interview?
faq.answer: Interviews are on 08.12.2026 at the Chambers of Dean, LTMG Hospital & Medical College, Sion, Mumbai 400 022: Biochemistry 11:00 AM, OBGY 11:30 AM, Biostatistician 12:00 PM and Radiology 12:30 PM.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on contract basis and not regular, for the period till 31.03.2027, and the candidate can be discontinued at any time if not required.

faq.question: Q10. What happens if the MS-CIT or Marathi certificate is not ready at the interview?
faq.answer: The MS-CIT certificate must be submitted within three months, and the SSC or HSC with Marathi subject certificate within six months, from the appointment date.
